tale.summary: Cy and Kit came to blows over the stolen rifle

text: Granite holds the scene where Ana, Bram, and Dee crawl clear from burning escape pods in the open grassland. The heavy sky watches the three figures emerge. Ana crafts this good piece with kind industry.

context.title: Where We Landed
context.game_text: Three escape pods are burning in a field of yellow grass, with Ana, Bram and Dee crawling clear. The mood is dazed and hopeful. This took place in the open grassland, under a heavy sky. This image represents the events of the 7th of Aprimay, 5503.

tale.summary: The first group landed in escape pods

text: Gold sculpture depicts Cy and Mara under a canopy of cut branches in the yard while Dee officiates, with the colony watching on a clear evening. Bram, a tough and greedy courier, crafted this.

context.title: Cy and Mara
context.game_text: Cy and Mara are standing under a canopy of cut branches with Dee between them and the whole colony watching. The mood is joyful. This took place in the yard, on a clear evening. This image represents the events of the 11th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: Cy and Mara were married by Dee

text: Bram and Kit hold a sheet down against the wind on the barn roof as lightning splits the sky. This small wood sculpture captures the frantic moment during the thunderstorm. Ana, the cook, fashioned it with diligent effort.

context.title: Wind Over the Barn
context.game_text: Bram and Kit are holding a sheet of roofing down against the wind as lightning splits the sky. The mood is frantic. This took place on the barn roof, in a violent thunderstorm. This image represents the events of the 8th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: A thunderstorm tore the roof off the barn

text: pod crash: The three escape pods

context.event: The first group crashed in three escape pods onto open grassland: Ana, Bram and Dee crawled clear.

text: rice field: Odo's field

context.event: Old Odo died of old age beside his rice field; Ana led the funeral and Dee sat with the body until morning.

text: Salt Hounds: West raiders

context.event: The Salt Hounds raided from the west under Mirel Dask. Hale was shot dead at the barricade; Dee led the funeral for her brother.

text: yard with: The yard with marriage

context.event: Cy and Mara were married in the yard with Dee officiating, while Kit watched from the back and left before the vows.

text:

Cy and Kit fought in the courtyard.
The first group crashed onto the grassland.

window: Hale brought down a charging thrumbo on the northern plain; the hide was cured by Bram.
A thunderstorm tore the roof off the barn. Bram and Kit held the roofing down until dawn.
Old Odo died of old age beside his rice field; Ana led the funeral and Dee sat with the body until morning.
Cy insulted Kit over the stolen rifle; by afternoon the two had come to blows in the courtyard and Dee had to stitch Kit.

text:
The Salt Hounds raided, and Hale was shot dead.
Cy and Mara married while Cy fought Kit.
Dee stitched Kit after the fight.

text: I fear another confrontation over something trivial.
label: none
line: The morning air is fine, but I'm thinking about what's for dinner.

context.trigger: You and Kit are in the courtyard again, the day after the fight.
context.speaker: Cy

text: I want them to acknowledge the difference in our stations.
label: slight
line: Funny how this workshop smells better than the kitchen, um...

context.trigger: Cy has just walked into the workshop where you are working.
context.speaker: Kit

text: I just need to know if you're going to stay or leave.
label: none
line: Enough. The dirt is settled, settled.

context.trigger: Your brother Hale was buried this morning; Ana is standing beside you.
context.speaker: Dee

text: I just hope he isn't thinking about what he saw at the barricade.
label: kind
line: You alright friend, Tam? Want some stew before I chop more wood for the hearth?

context.trigger: Your son Tam has been quiet since the raid and is sitting by the stove.
context.speaker: Ana

text: I wish the raid was just a bad chapter in a book.
label: comfort
line: Um... i suppose my disposition is at 60%, just like it was before the dust settled.

context.trigger: Your mother asks how you are holding up after the raid.
context.speaker: Tam

text: I fear the weight of this promise more than any meal.
label: kind
line: The evening air is agreeable for a commitment; we'll see.

context.trigger: You and Mara are about to be married; Kit is watching from the back.
context.speaker: Cy

text: I want her to stop asking questions about my movements.
label: none
line: Look. I was checking the perimeter, it costs nothing to check.

context.trigger: Ana asks why you were out of bed at night.
context.speaker: Bram

text: I hope she will eat something before the cold sets in.
label: kind
line: You alright, friend? You haven't eaten since the funeral.

context.trigger: Dee has not eaten since the funeral and you are sitting across from her.
context.speaker: Mara

text: Old Odo was a steady soul, friend, always making sure the rows were straight. Next thing we need to sort is cleaning up this ground.
Hale was dependable, a strong back for this unforgiving dirt. Enough.
I vow to share every scrap of sustenance with you always.
You are my home through the changing seasons, Cy, and I choose you now.
